AUTHOR: Villon
TITLE: Coral Reef Fish Detection and Recognition in Underwater Videos by Supervised Machine Learning: Comparison Between Deep Learning and HOG+SVM Methods
REGION: Coral reefs (MARBEC laboratory database; location not stated in text, Mayotte per metadata)
SPECIES: Acanthurus lineatus, A. nigrofuscus, Chromis ternatensis, C. viridis/atripectoralis, Pomacentrus sulfureus, Pseudanthias squamipinnis, Zebrasoma scopas, Ctenochaetus striatus (+ background, part-of-fish, generic fish classes)
DATA: Own MARBEC HD diver video; 13,000 fish thumbnails for training (augmented), 4 test videos with 400 expert-annotated frames
V_EV: Sec. 4: 'The video acquisition were not deep ... but the light is moving with the waves, bringing many distortions'; Sec. 1 mentions 'sediments and dirt'; no quantitative visibility
D2: 13,000 training thumbnails from training videos / 400 frames from 4 separate test videos
D_EV: Sec. 4: 'We used 4 test videos (which are different from the training videos) to experiment our complete process'
R_EV: Sec. 4: 'The 4 videos were taken on coral reefs, and the diver was holding the camera' - same MARBEC database/campaign as training, no other site or dataset
C_EV: Sec. 4 / Fig. 6: 'We also show on Figure 6 the relation between recall and precision with respect to the threshold T' (T = 98% used in Table 3)
E_EV: Sec. 4 / Table 3: 'Results (recall, precision and F-Measure) of the entire detection/recognition process' - only detection metrics reported
ARCH: GoogLeNet-style CNN (27 layers, 9 inception modules, softmax) with multi-resolution sliding window + motion score; baseline HOG + SVM (libsvm RBF SVR, one-vs-all)
METR: Precision, recall, F-measure per test video at IoU 0.5; precision-recall vs threshold T
NOTE: Per-video results (Table 3) vary with 'texture of the background' and species, not visibility strata. Training videos cropped into thumbnails; test on 4 different videos, so split unit coded as video. E4=FNR derived from reported recall. Pretraining not stated. Study region not named in the text (metadata says Mayotte).
